fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of the "git" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
fields.name: Shell Execution via Git - Linux
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (src.process.image.path contains "/git" and (src.process.cmdline contains " -p " and src.process.cmdline contains "help") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "bash 0<&1" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "dash 0<&1" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "sh 0<&1")))
